title-group.article-title: Near-infrared prediction of fat content in fatty duck liver: a calibration table supplied as an image

abstract.p: A constructed fixture. Near-infrared reflectance spectra of fatty duck liver were calibrated against chemical fat content. The calibration coefficients are given in Table 2, which the publisher supplied only as an image.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: Livers from overfed Pekin ducks were scanned at 1100 to 2500 nm. Fat content was measured by Soxhlet extraction and expressed as a percentage of fresh weight. Partial least squares regression related spectra to fat content.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: Fat content ranged from 38 to 61 percent of fresh weight. The calibration achieved a standard error of prediction of 2.1 percentage points (Table 2).

sec.title: Discussion
sec.p: Spectroscopy can replace chemical extraction for routine fat measurement in fatty duck liver once calibrated.
